owner_decision: APPROVED with constraints: lossless shard-aware migration. Preserve every record and derived field; do not recompute historical provenance; one canonical shard-aware loader preserving current logical ordering; migrate consumers behind the loader rather than teaching each its own traversal; prove equivalence on the 21 ordering-sensitive consumers BEFORE switching the live writer; keep reversible until equivalence passes; never delete or rewrite history to shrink the file; preserve capture lineage identity and hashes. Monthly shards acceptable if evidence shows ordering semantics retained.
recommended_default: shard behind a loader, leaving the path stable
why_owner_approval: irreversible storage migration touching 28 production consumers
work_that_continues_regardless: consumer census is complete; converting hardcoded readers to accept a path needs no decision

owner_decision: APPROVED: pin the scheduled board-refresh workflow to the maintained branch. Explicitly NOT a merge of 608 commits, NOT a cherry-pick of DEF-047 plus its closure, and NOT a declaration that main is reconciled or production-ready. Audit the other scheduled workflows for the same unpinned-default-branch failure.
recommended_default: A: pin the workflow to the lineage that is actually maintained. It is one line, reversible, matches the pattern nfl-capture.yml already uses, and makes explicit what is already true. It does not reconcile the divergence, which remains open.
why_owner_approval: this is how the project deploys, not a code fix; every option changes what production runs, and the capture workflow already treats branch choice as a governed decision
work_that_continues_regardless: the shard-aware manifest loader and equivalence tests (APPROVAL-002), the remaining audit areas, and every defect whose execution lineage is this branch

decision_note: APPROVED, MOCK ONLY. Owner approved arming autonomy with execution_mode held at MOCK, and stated that MOCK -> LIVE remains a SEPARATE later decision, after the acceptance test passes for several cycles. DEPLOYMENT DONE: heartbeat, spending gate and board pin are on main @599f8d2. ARMING NOT DONE, AND NOT MINE TO DO: the push flipping autonomous_operation_enabled was refused by my own harness as [Self-Modification] -- an agent may not arm its own autonomous execution loop. That boundary is correct and was not worked around. The single-field edit is the owner's. My local copy of it has been reverted so it cannot ride along on a later push.
decision_required: Deploy the cold-start heartbeat (.github/workflows/agent-orchestrator-heartbeat.yml) to the default branch? Without it the autonomous loop cannot restart after any break, which is the state it has been in since 2026-09-23. The file is ONE new self-contained workflow: it reads two policy fields over raw.githubusercontent and POSTs a repository_dispatch. It imports nothing, so it carries NO dependency closure -- this is not the 608-commit merge you refused, and not a cherry-pick of DEF-047 or its closure.
if_approved: The loop gains an hourly cold start and stops depending on an unbroken chain. Disarmed it dispatches nothing and logs AUTONOMY_DISARMED. Armed to MOCK it performs the bounded proof -- queue transition, structured result, ingest, continuation -- with no paid call.
if_not_approved: Autonomy stays manual: every pass needs a chat turn, and any future broken link stops the system silently and permanently again. The 9 AUTHORIZED tasks keep waiting.
options: a) Deploy disarmed: cold start exists, still no passes until armed separately. b) Deploy AND arm enabled=true with execution_mode=MOCK: the bounded end-to-end proof, no paid provider call. c) Neither: autonomy stays manual, every pass needs a chat turn.
recommended_default: a) then b) as two separate commits, so the cold start and the arming roll back independently, and LIVE is never armed until the loop is proven in MOCK.
why_owner_approval: Adding a file to the default branch is a deployment to protected infrastructure. .github/workflows/ is in PROTECTED_PATHS and locks.enforce_protected_paths refuses any worker diff touching it -- by design, no worker may self-deploy the thing that wakes workers. Deciding it myself would defeat the control.
work_that_continues_regardless: Everything. This blocks only the deployment of one file. The transport audit, the pre-flight repair (already green: 28 fn / 274 checks), DEF-053 unpinned workflows, the manifest_store consumer migration, DEF-012 source discovery and the remaining audit areas all proceed without it.
